v100_16gb_forecast.method: Capacity proxy measured on a V100 32 GB with a 15360 MiB budget leaving physical-card headroom; first-order prediction assumes comparable effective CPU/RAM bandwidth and GPU clocks.

dual_socket_capacity_proxy_scope: Both sockets: 36 physical cores / 72 allowed logical CPUs; 35 or 71 workers plus host; V100 32GB hardware limited to 16384 or 15360 MiB per enabled device; host weights interleaved across NUMA nodes. No physical 16GB cards tested.

dual_socket_v100_16gb_forecast.method: 15360 MiB per-device capacity proxies; assumes comparable clocks, effective CPU/RAM bandwidth and cooling.
